description: Comptage vélo - Données compteurs 2020 - Anglet is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. This dataset lists hourly bike counts by meter and location of counting sites in 2020. A metering site may be equipped with a meter in the case of a one-way bike development or two meters in the case of a bi-directional cycling development. Coverage: Ville d'Anglet. The portal shows the English title as "Bike counting – Data meters 2020 – Anglet" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Anglet. Its keywords include comptage, velo, mobilite-espace-public, compteur, mobilite-douce, deux-roues. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
